readout_other: Beck Anxiety Inventory; Beck Depression Inventory-II; PCL-5; Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index; exit survey
direction_notes: Mean BAI score fell by 14.9 points after 4 weeks of daily treatment (uncontrolled pre-post); BDI, PCL-5 and PSQI also fell. Direction of neural effect not assessed.
safety_notes: One mild adverse event: a participant reported feeling jittery for a short time afterwards, classified as probably device related.

target.label: auricular branch of the vagus nerve

timing.protocol_description: Participants completed 5 minutes of LIFU to the auricular branch of the vagus nerve each day at home for 4 weeks using the ZenBud headset (device shuts down after 29 minutes).

source_quotes.n_subjects: Methods: This study was a pre-post intervention study design for which we recruited 28 participants with a Beck Anxiety Inventory score of 16 points or greater.
